source_title: NASA Announces Mid-Power Electric Rocket Challenge for US Companies
source_excerpt: NASA launched a new competition inviting U.S. companies to produce prototypes of mid-power Hall effect thrusters – a type of electric propulsion system considered crucial for future space operations and exploration.
